text:
nora: Heads-up — CI microbench on my PR (PR #20420) just failed a smallbench threshold. kv_hit_rate microbench regressed ~+3.8% vs main, causing the job to flip. attaching CI output + quick traces below.

kevin: can you paste the CI job link + the diff output?

nora: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/5243 (job 5243)

nora: ```
smallbench.kv_hit_rate: baseline=12.3ms current=12.78ms delta=+3.8% (threshold=+2.0%)
flamegraph: https://artifacts/internal/5243/flame.svg
hot path: runtime::batcher::choose_kernel -> runtime::kv::touch_entry -> kernel::attention::dispatch
stack samples show 22% more time in runtime::batcher::slot_rebalance
```

jun: that hot path points at the batcher heuristics. did anything change on main recently around kernel/autoselect or batch slotting?

nora: i didn't touch batching in this PR (just quantization tuning). main had the kernel-autoselect tweak landed yesterday: commit 0xabcde - "autoselect: prefer kernel with higher throughput when seq_len > 128". might be related.

ci-bot: Test summary: PR #20420 - smallbench.kv_hit_rate FAILED (3.8% over threshold). Related CI runs: compare 5241 -> 5243. Note: recent merges include commit 0xabcde on main.

kevin: ok let's bisect main range (before/after 0xabcde) quickly. i'll run the microbench locally in a docker identical to CI. give me a few.

sophia: also curious if kv cache hit distribution changed. nora — can you dump kv hit histogram from CI run?

nora: added histogram to artifacts: https://artifacts/internal/5243/kv_hist.json

nora: histogram shows more frequent short-lived slot evictions; hit rate down ~1.5% and eviction churn up ~8% in the samples we have.

ryan: that aligns with slot_rebalance increase in the flamegraph. if kernel autoselect changes the chosen kernel it could change batching window durations and trigger more evictions.

kevin: bisect result: 0xabcde is the culprit. running a quick revert locally (checkout main^ && cherry-pick -x) and re-running microbench -> numbers back to baseline.

kevin: reproduction snippet I used: ```
# run microbench in CI-like env
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work redwood/microbench:ci sh -c '
  ./run_smallbench --bench kv_hit_rate --iters 200 --seed 42'
```

kevin: flamegraphs attached from local runs: before-0xabcde.svg (baseline), after-0xabcde.svg (regressed). diff shows slot_rebalance up from 3% -> 25% of samples.

jun: thanks — that narrows it. commit message mentioned prefer throughput for long seqs; maybe the kernel chosen has slightly different batch pacing leading to more slot churn for short sequences.

sophia: can we attempt a targeted fix instead of revert? maybe tune the autoselect heuristic to consider cache pressure / slot occupancy for small sequences.

nora: agree, but this is blocking my PR rollout and CI gating. i vote we revert the autoselect change on main and open a follow-up to add heuristic for cache-pressure.

ryan: +1 revert for now. create a revert PR and mark it rollout-blocker.

kevin: i'll open the revert PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/reverts/rt-1245 (WIP)

kevin: `git revert --no-commit 0xabcde && ./scripts/run_microbench_smoke.sh` confirmed revert restores baseline.

ci-bot: Noted: revert PR rt-1245 opened by kevin. CI will run. Tagging oncall and marking main as blocked for rollout until revert CI passes.

jun: for the follow-up patch, i'll prototype a change to autoselect to include `avg_slot_holding_time` and `kv_eviction_rate` as tie-breakers. we should add a unit test with synthetic slot churn to avoid regressions.

nora: thanks everyone. i'll re-run my PR's CI after the revert lands. tagging @sre oncall in case we need to pause deploys. :thumbsup:

kevin: CI for revert is green on first run (rt-1245 job 5251). smallbench.kv_hit_rate back within threshold (0.6% delta). merging revert now.

sophia: good call. leaving a note on the original commit 0xabcde to track follow-up.

nora: PR #20420 CI re-run now shows green. moving forward with merge. thanks all for quick triage!

ryan: action items: (1) jun to prototype autoselect fix + tests, (2) add microbench smoke for slot churn to CI golden set, (3) add perf-monitor alert for sudden slot_rebalance regressions.

kevin: i'll open a tiny tracking issue for the CI smoke test. https://issues.internal/RED-3312

ci-bot: Thread closed: revert merged, affected PR re-run green.
